preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array is at least 1 and at most 200,000.
The maximum number of operations is at least 1 and at most 200,000.
The number invented by Maxim is at least 1 and at most 10^9.
Each element of the array is at most 10^9 in absolute value.

postconditions.description: The output array has the same number of elements as the input array.

postconditions.expression: all(b_i % x == a_i % x for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each element of the output array is congruent to the corresponding element of the input array modulo x.
The product of all elements in the output array is less than or equal to the product of all elements in the input array.

postconditions.expression: min(prod(b) for b in all_possible_arrays(a, k, x))
postconditions.description: The product of all elements in the output array is minimized over all possible arrays that can be obtained by applying at most k operations to the input array.
